summary: Locate the position of the first qualifying item.
documentation: findIndex calls a predicate from the beginning until it finds a truthy result. It returns that element’s zero-based position, or -1 when nothing qualifies. Unlike find, it returns a position rather than the item itself.
inputs: A callback receiving the current item, its index and the array.
caution: Index 0 is a valid match but is falsey. Compare with -1 instead of using the index as a Boolean.
scenarios: Find the first overdue item before scrolling to its row.
Identify where a stock reorder queue first needs attention.
Locate the first invalid field in a form’s validation results.
title: Find the first stockout
problem: Input is an array of nonnegative stock quantities. Return the index of the first quantity equal to zero, or -1 if none exist.
goal: Use Array.findIndex() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
hint: Stop at the first exact zero, including at index 0.
